note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is a key-bag whose shape changes between rounds: six records carry only `{factory, generator, round}`, most rounds add `seed`/`domain` plus either `plant` or `designed`/`kind`/`stack`, and six carry `lane` on top of that, so the datasets-server infers a nine-field struct from one shard and then cannot cast the thin records. Declaring `meta`, `reward` and `tool_call.args` as `json` fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`command`, `url`, `path`, `args`, `old`/`new`, `target`, `contents`, `pattern`)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on every record, plus `retries` (722), `plan_changes` (356), `handoff` (334), `duration_min` (209), `wasted_calls` (209) and `xfailed` (146) on subsets

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `seed` (724), `domain` (724), `plant` (368), `kind` (356), `designed` (356), `stack` (356) and `lane` (6) on subsets

disclosures.summary: Six records carry the thin `meta` shape `{factory, generator, round}` with no `seed`, `domain`, `plant`, `designed`, `kind` or `stack`. They are the records the inferred struct schema died on; they are kept exactly as generated.
Six records in rounds 2 to 4 carry `meta.lane` (value `b`), the widest `meta` shape in the dataset and the one the datasets-server infers from. They are TLS episodes; only the extra key is unusual.

Four records in rounds 180 and 181 are search-index-rebuild leftover-mill payloads (Xapian / Vespa reindex goals, `sir-` id prefix, `leftover3d` in the id) that were dest-stamped `meta.factory: ssl-cert-rotation-factory`. They are not TLS rotation episodes and should not be read as such. They are the same leftover-mill pattern as the `sir-*-leftover3c-*` records called out for incident-response; they are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: Every one of the 730 records is stamped `meta.factory: ssl-cert-rotation-factory` and `meta.generator: grok-4.6`, and every record is an episode: there is no preference-pair or foreign-kind mix.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
